management.title: Management
management.description.projects: Manage accessible projects, project resources and grants with clear configuration and execution scopes.
management.description.teams: Manage organization teams and collaboration, with project access checked separately.
management.description.models: Inspect public model catalogs, configuration sources and pricing states from current tools.
management.description.tools: Connect execution tools and inspect worker resources, scheduling and actual probe states.
management.description.billing: Manage recorded usage, quotas and estimated rates; reconcile unreported or unknown charges individually.
management.description.organization: Manage organization accounts, members, language preferences, integrations and access tokens.
management.project_scope: View project information, resources and access
management.model_source: Select a tool source to read its public models and deployments within the current project.
management.model_scope: Reads bind the tool version, configuration digest and current project authorization without calling a model.
management.models_empty_help: Connect a tool in Tool Management, then return here to select it.
management.choose_source_help: Select an execution tool to see the models and configuration it publishes.
management.invalid_model_source: The tool could not be verified for this project and selection. Reload or choose another tool.
management.revoked_model_source: This tool was removed. Choose another source or connect a tool in Tool Management.
management.tool_catalog_boundary: A tool catalog does not establish provider identity, model health or successful execution.
management.no_model_options: No selectable models for this tool
management.no_model_options_help: This tool supports model deployments, but its current worker inventory lists none. Check the worker configuration and update its report.
management.source_has_no_catalog: This tool publishes no model catalog
management.source_has_no_catalog_help: The current tool configuration provides no model information. Check it in Tool Management or choose another source.
management.fixed_model_help: The tool configuration specifies this model. Check run evidence for model identity, availability and usage.
management.model_boundary: Execution workers and the Go host manage model deployments and credentials. This directory shows public configuration. Billing manages rates, quotas and usage.
